pages.text: Create runs on $(thing)rotation$(). Many other machines run on $(thing)Forge Energy (FE)$(). They never mix on their own: you need a converter block in between.$(br2)Full detail: $(l:industry/power_compared)Rotation vs Electricity$(/l).

pages.title: Rotation to FE
pages.text: Crafts & Additions' Alternator turns spin into FE. It needs at least 32 RPM.

pages.title: FE to Rotation
pages.text: Crafts & Additions' Electric Motor turns FE back into spin at the RPM you set.

Rotation sources beyond water, wind and steam:$(li)TFMG engines burning oil products$(li)The Create Nuclear reactor$(li)Create Propulsion's Stirling Engine, which turns heat into spin$(li)Electric Motors running on FE

Things that want FE: Create Propulsion's Ion Thruster, Flight Control's vector ion thrusters and the Deep Seas Electrolyzer on submarines.$(br2)TFMG wires its own voltage circuits, but its connectors can import or export FE.
